en: Jose Rizal wrote his famous novel Noli Me Tangere in Berlin, Germany, not in the Philippines.
Marcela Agoncillo and her assistants sewed the first official Philippine flag in Hong Kong, not Manila.
The Philippines officially celebrates Independence Day on June 12, not July 4.
The majestic Philippine eagle, not the common maya, is the official national bird of the Philippines.
The white sampaguita, not the rare waling-waling orchid, is the official national flower of the Philippines.
Emilio Aguinaldo is officially recognized as the first President of the Philippines, not Andres Bonifacio.
The national language Filipino is based on Tagalog but incorporates words from other Philippine and foreign languages.
The legislative branch creates laws, while the executive and judicial branches enforce and interpret those laws.
Fe del Mundo was the first Asian woman admitted to Harvard Medical School, not the first Filipino doctor.
The vibrant Sinulog festival honoring the Santo Niño is celebrated in Cebu, not Manila.
Emilio Jacinto is known as the Brains of the Katipunan, not Jose Rizal.
Arnis, not basketball, is the official national martial art and sport of the Philippines.
